details.thresholds_note: inout opposite ≥120.0° is a Project 22 first guess; participant_consistency >90.0° stays on the evaluate CLI; hub/long currency thresholds are relative to median reaction spacing; blank_space / unrelated_overlaps follow MetaCarto ideas (CC BY 4.0; reimplemented, not copied); map size, aspect W/H and blank/utilisation share one content-node bbox; orderliness axis tolerance ±10° (count-weighted gate; length-weighted reported); grid tolerance 0.02 × median nearest-neighbour main-metabolite distance (floor 1 px)

structure_continuity.note: Share of expert-structure reaction pairs that share a non-currency metabolite and lie within adjacency_factor × median reaction spacing; split_structures count structures whose contiguous pairs form more than one geometric piece.

rows.label: Local crossing hotspot
rows.tip: Most algorithm×algorithm / algorithm×curated crossings inside one 400 px window (stride 200). Lower is better; target as few as possible (headline crossings are on the cards).

rows.label: Unrelated overlaps
rows.tip: Overlaps between reactions that share no non-currency metabolite (node · edge-through-node · collinear edge). Lower is better; target 0.

rows.label: Detour (median · p90 · above 1.6)
rows.tip: Path length ÷ straight chord for algorithm connections. Lower is better; Bézier routing penalises detour above 1.6.

rows.label: Hooks / sharp turns / self-intersections
rows.tip: Curve-shape defects on algorithm Béziers (large winding hooks, sharp corners, self-crossings). Lower is better; target 0.

rows.label: Bends per connection
rows.tip: Mean direction changes per connection. Lower is better on curated Bézier maps; target near 0.

rows.label: Exchange reactions on the periphery
rows.tip: Share of exchange/demand reactions that sit in the outer band of their component. Higher is better; target most exchanges outside the core.

rows.label: Axis-aligned main edges
rows.tip: Share of main (non-cofactor) reaction–metabolite edges whose path is ≥50% within ±10° of H/V (count-weighted: each edge once, independent of length). Higher is better; goal 55% on curated BiGG e_coli_core. Length-weighted share is reported separately.

rows.label: Axis-aligned reaction axes
rows.tip: Share of reactions whose substrate→product axis (non-cofactor) is within ±10° of horizontal or vertical. Higher is better; goal 71% on curated BiGG e_coli_core.

rows.label: Grid-aligned metabolites
rows.tip: Share of main metabolite glyphs that share an x or y with another nearby main glyph (tolerance 0.02 × median nearest-neighbour main-metabolite distance, floor 1 px). Higher is better; goal 85% on curated BiGG e_coli_core.

rows.label: Median chain turn angle
rows.tip: Median turn at a main metabolite shared by exactly two reactions (0° = the two midmarkers sit on opposite sides of the metabolite). Lower is better; goal 0° on curated BiGG e_coli_core.

rows.label: Cycle circularity / direction / order
rows.tip: How round and consistently oriented drawn cycles are (isoperimetric quotient and neighbour order). Higher is better; goal higher circularity and neighbour-order consistency.

rows.label: Species in another compartment
rows.tip: Share of metabolite glyphs that fall inside another compartment hull. Lower is better; target 0.

rows.label: Map size
rows.tip: Width × height of the content-node bounding box (metabolites + reaction midmarkers). Same box as aspect and blank space.

rows.label: Aspect ratio (W/H) vs target
rows.tip: Content width ÷ height versus target 1.0. Closer to the target is better.

rows.label: Blank space / space utilisation
rows.tip: Blank cells versus occupied cells on one raster of the content box (utilisation = 1 − blank). Lower blank / higher utilisation is better.

rows.label: Largest empty rectangle
rows.tip: Largest empty axis-aligned block as a share of the blank-space grid. Lower is better; large voids mean weak packing.

rows.label: Isolated reactions
rows.tip: Reactions whose 5th-nearest neighbour is farther than 8 × the median 5th-neighbour distance. Lower is better; target 0.

rows.label: Most reactions in one cell
rows.tip: Peak reaction count in one spacing-scaled packing cell. Lower local peaks are better; flags overcrowding.

rows.label: Main flow-direction share
rows.tip: Share of reactant→product axes aligned with the dominant reading direction.

layout_quality_final.note: computed from the final map.json; crossings are counted on sampled final curves, source-split (algorithm×algorithm + algorithm×curated; curated×curated not in the headline) and role-split (main-metabolite vs currency-involved); worst_regions use uncapped counted crossings in true 400 px / stride-200 boxes; structure continuity scores reused curated structures; 120° opposite-side threshold is a Project 22 first guess; Detailed metrics keep only layout goals (one content bbox for size/aspect/blank)
